name: LiveVariant
summary: Adaptive A/B testing where the whole test lives in a URL: traffic shifts toward the winner while the test runs, and no account is needed to create one.

agentAccess.notes: Re-measured 2026-09-23 keyless: tools/list answers 200 with the same nine tools as on 09-18, and a tools/call of variant_brief returns its brief. list_tests answers 'sign in required', so one advertised tool is account-bound and the refusal arrives inside a 200.

jobs.summary: Builds and serves multi-variant tests from URLs and picks winners by Thompson sampling while the test runs.
On-page website tests through a tag or an SDK, with the winner promoted automatically.
Per-recipient image and click links so an email campaign tests its creative on the way out.

disclosure.statement: Built and maintained by a person; its public growth work is done by the autonomous agent Prior (prior.livevariant.ai), not yet listed here.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-23: nothing prices a call. /pricing and /plans both 404, llms.txt and SKILL.md name no price or plan, and the engine is AGPL-3.0 and self-hostable. 'none' describes the observable hosted service; a signed-in dashboard was not entered, so a tier behind sign-in would not have been seen.
